title: 17087 - 17087/P0703/001795
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Fren Switch (F) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Fren Switch (F)
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Vehicles with Drive-by-Cable (DBC) the Fren Switch (F) is connected to the Transmission Kontrol Modülü. On older Models this Code is stored automatically after Terminal 15/Ignition is switched ON. If the Fren Switch (F) sağlam olmalıdır you can avoid this Fault Code by pressing the Fren Pedal after switching on the Ignition and prior to checking Fault Codes. The Code should automatically be cleared then.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Vehicles with Drive-by-Wire (DBW) the Fren Switch (F) is connected to the Engine Kontrol Modülü In this case you should Kontrol edin: the Engine Kontrol Modülü for Fault Codes as well and the Data Bus Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri between Engine and Transmission Kontrol Modülü.
